user.title: Connect to your TerraMaster NAS
user.description: Home Assistant talks to the NAS directly on your local network. Nothing is sent to TerraMaster.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the NAS, for example 192.168.1.10.
data_description.port: Port of the TOS web interface. The default is 8181.
data_description.username: A TOS user account. Any account can read the sensors; an administrator account is only needed to change the fan mode.
data_description.password: The password for that account. It is stored locally and only ever sent to the NAS.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with your TerraMaster NAS
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {host} are no longer accepted. Enter them again to reconnect.

data_description.username: A TOS user account, usually the same one you used before.
data_description.password: The current password for that account.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the NAS. Check the host and port, and that the TOS web interface is open.
error.invalid_auth: The NAS rejected that username or password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This NAS is already set up in Home Assistant.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between updates. Reading temperatures runs SMART queries on the NAS and takes a few seconds, so values below 30 add load for little benefit.
data_description.overheat_protection: If the hottest drive reaches the threshold while the fan is in a fixed mode, switch it back to Automatic. A fixed mode disables the firmware's own temperature ramp, so this prevents the drives from cooking.
data_description.overheat_celsius: Temperature at which automatic fan control is restored. TerraMaster warns about drive life above 55 °C.

set_fan_mode_failed.message: Could not change the fan mode on the NAS: {error}

fan_mode_not_permitted.message: This TerraMaster account is not permitted to change the fan mode. Reading sensors works with any account, but fan control requires an administrator account.
